1. Check Clay embeddings coverage for the area.
2. Confirm scenes with a STAC search.
3. Write the plan: data and why, access, processing steps, limitations.

Plan: the Clay embeddings cover this part of the Terai (2021 is missing). Find cells most similar to the confirmed flood-affected cell in the same month, then verify the top candidates with low-cloud Sentinel-2 L2A scenes from Earth Search (sentinel-cogs, us-west-2, no Requester-Pays) and a water index. Limitations: similarity is not flood evidence; monsoon cloud cover limits optical checks.

VERDICT: approve
The plan matches the tool results.
